receipts.receiptSource: Original Receipt from 'The Curry Cook's Assistant' by Daniel Santiagoe, 1887
receipts.receiptText:
TOAST CURRY.

Prepare some Curry gravy, same as Madras Curry. Now toast two slices of bread; cut thin, and in diamond shape. After toasted, dish the toast on a vegetable dish, and pour over the gravy you prepared, and send to table hot, with Curry and rice, samball, etc.

receipts.receiptSource: Original Receipt from 'Home Chat' Magazine, No182, p611
receipts.receiptText: TOAST CURRY Cut up an onion into very thin rings; chop two heads of garlic, two bay leaves, and fry all these in 2 oz. of butter with 12 cloves until nicely browned. Then add one tablespoonful of curry powder and stir. Then put in one large cupful of good tomato ketchup, a teaspoonful of tarragon vinegar and the seeds of 8 cardamoms; simmer gently for about fifteen minutes until the mixture is thick. Spread generously on rounds of fried bread. Garnish with parsley and serve hot.
